entries.embedded_english: Here it comes!  The artillery boys keep even better time that Big Ben.
So we sneak in behind them eh, Sarge?
Taylor! Get that door open!
Sharpe, there's a Jerry sniper rifle here. Reckon you can get a bead on that gun crew?
They’re breaking in downstairs!
There's another 88 to the north. They're well dug in; It'll take a while to work round their flank.
Good work, lads!
Take out that half-track!
Flank the half-track and take out that damn MG!
Fall back! We hold them here!
Jerry's waiting for the river crossing. Come on lads, this is where we earn our breakfast!
Half-track!
Off the road! Into the house!
Panzer!
I'm beginning to think they don't like us.
Last push, lads. Don't let me down now!
Righto lads! Taylor, Sharpe - take out the checkpoint.
That's the ticket, lad. We take out their gun positions so our boys can cross without Jerry shelling the blazes out of them.
My God!  What the hell is that?
Where are those damn LVTs?
Sharpe! Get down there and hold 'em back!
I found a Jerry ammo dump, Sarge - top of the big house.
88 out of action Sarge.
Sarge! Flak 88 ahead.
Sarge, we've got company!
More Jerries coming up from the river.
Get that Panzerschrek into position!
Jerry tank!
Couple of Jerries on a check point round the corner. All quiet otherwise, Sarge.
Nebelwerfer....bloody big Jerry rockets, son.  You all know the drill here - kill the crews and put 'em out of action.
They're coming in now, Sarge!
Trucks to the north, Sarge, their bringing in more troops.
They're in the house!
Over that gap in the wall! On the double lads!
Knock out that 88 lads.
Jerry's downstairs!
Good shooting men.
Here comes the bloody cavalry!
There's a big Jerry column heading our way!
Get to the ammo store and find us a Panzerschrek!
It won't be for long. We're running late and the artillery barrage is going to start any time now.
Jerry's waiting for the Rhine crossing, but he's not looking this way. All their guns will be pointing at the river.
Where are those LVTs?
Go downstairs and get on that MG, Sharpe.
Sarge, I can see them working round our flank. Not sure what they're up to.
Sharpe! Get up into the house and see if you can find anything useful. I need that gun position taken out.
Spread out, get to cover!
Jerry on the top floor!
Get down! Keep away from the windows!
Gun crew's dead, Sarge.
Taylor! Get upstairs! I want to know what's coming our way.
Sharpe! Go find Taylor and tell him to get his backside here now!
Good show, men.   Us and the yanks are across the Rhine, and Jerry's on the run.  The first beers are on me, when we get to Berlin...
Easy now, lads. Keep an eye out for Jerry.
Get a move on, lads. We're running out of time. Those yank LVTs will be hitting the water any minute.
